title: PAR-20/7G.3 TABLESTYLE root-alias refusal

finding.source: The TABLE/TABLESTYLE preflight rejected duplicate canonical ACAD_TABLESTYLE NOD entries but did not reject a differently named NOD key targeting the same style dictionary.
finding.risk: An ambiguous NOD-to-dictionary graph could be silently normalized by the DXF writer.
finding.scope: TABLESTYLE root graph only; no claim is made about all named-object-dictionary families.

implementation: Applied the shared required named-object-root validator to TABLESTYLE graph preparation.
The validator requires one canonical ACAD_TABLESTYLE key, exactly one matching dictionary record owned by the actual owner-zero NOD, and no other NOD key aliasing that target.
Extended the existing generated TABLE/TABLESTYLE selector for ASCII and Binary with alias refusal, seeded destination preservation, corrected same-adapter retry, and strict root/handle readback.
